headline: Strategic Line Boils Across Six Active Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show the front has shifted since the previous edition, with several old pressure points cooling while fresh action flares elsewhere. Stlican Shelf has become the busiest contested sector, rising to 47 ownership events in twenty-four hours and four in the latest two, with Breaker Town accounting for most of the movement; holdings are four Warden and five Colonial. Weathered Expanse remains a furnace at 52 events, though its recent pace is below the prior edition, and Wightwalk and Frostmarch still lead the tally. Fisherman’s Row has cooled to 39 events, with three in two hours, after its earlier burst around Eidolo, Dankana Post, and Black Well. Callahan’s Passage is quieter over the full day at 21 events, but five occurred in the latest two hours, chiefly at The Crumbling Passage; nine bases remain Warden-held and one is neutral. Mooring County has likewise slackened to 12 events, with none in two hours. Linn Mercy now merits attention, recording eight events and three recent actions amid sharply rising casualty rates. Most other regions report no ownership movement.
